skus.name: PocketBlend Pro — 22oz Travel Smoothie Maker
skus.description_short: USB-C rechargeable 22oz blender that survives ice, fits in a tote, charges in 45 min for 20+ blends.
skus.description_long: PocketBlend Pro is a daily-driver portable blender built for commuters, gym-goers, and travelers who got burned by toy-grade competitors. 200W brushless motor crushes frozen fruit and ice without stalling, USB-C fast charge gives you 20+ blends per cycle, and the entire cup pops apart for top-rack dishwasher cleaning.
key_features: 200W brushless motor — crushes ice & frozen fruit
skus.usp: The only portable blender that lasts a full week of commutes without recharging AND actually crushes ice — solves the #1 complaint about BlendJet (pain_001).

skus.name: PocketBlend Travel Pouch
skus.description_short: Insulated neoprene sleeve sized for PocketBlend Pro — keeps smoothies cold for 4 hours.
skus.description_long: Made for the people who actually travel with their blender. Insulated neoprene sleeve with side mesh pocket for the USB-C cable, fits PocketBlend Pro snugly without crushing the lid.
skus.usp: First accessory designed specifically for portable-blender travelers (audience_002).

bundle_suggestions.name: Daily Commuter Bundle
bundle_suggestions.rationale: Pairs core SKU with the highest-affinity accessory; gives reason for AOV lift on first purchase.

pricing_strategy.rationale: Price $10 above BlendJet anchor to reinforce premium battery + ice-crush positioning. Compare_at_price $79 frames the discount and supports future promo windows. Margin 76% leaves room for paid acquisition (target CAC ≤ $25).
